_meta.note: 一個故事一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Water of the Past#001.src: The voice of the past echoes within this chamber...
Water of the Past#001.dst: {c1}この部屋には、過去の声が響き渡っている……{/}
Water of the Past#001.note: {c1}The voice of the past echoes within this chamber...{/}

Water of the Past#002.src: "The men of {p} do not truly know war."
Water of the Past#002.dst: {c1}「{p}の男たちは、戦争を本当の意味で理解していない。」{/}
Water of the Past#002.note: {c1}"The men of {p} do not truly know war."{/}

Water of the Past#003.src: "Sure, they fought the fight. But they did not lose the most."
Water of the Past#003.dst: {c1}「確かに、彼らは戦った。しかし、最も大きな損失を被ったのは彼らではなかった。」{/}
Water of the Past#003.note: {c1}"Sure, they fought the fight. But they did not lose the most."{/}

Water of the Past#004.src: "It is us, those who provide the food without the protection of walls or castles that suffer first."
Water of the Past#004.dst: {c1}「壁や城の守りもないまま食糧を供給している私たちこそが、真っ先に苦しむのだ。」{/}
Water of the Past#004.note: {c1}"It is us, those who provide the food without the protection of walls or castles that suffer first."{/}

Water of the Past#005.src: "We learned to fight for ourselves and produce the food for the army."
Water of the Past#005.dst: {c1}「私たちは、自分たちのために戦い、軍隊のための食糧を生産する方法を学んだ。」{/}
Water of the Past#005.note: {c1}"We learned to fight for ourselves and produce the food for the army."{/}

Water of the Past#006.src: "We even built our own water system. It allowed us the time we needed off the fields."
Water of the Past#006.dst: {c1}「私たちは独自の給水システムまで作り上げた。そのおかげで、畑から離れて必要な時間を確保できた。」{/}
Water of the Past#006.note: {c1}"We even built our own water system. It allowed us the time we needed off the fields."{/}

Water of the Past#007.src: "But where were the shining army of red and yellow when our supply was attacked?"
Water of the Past#007.dst: {c1}「でも、我々の補給部隊が襲撃されたとき、あの赤と黄色に輝く軍勢はどこにいたんだ？」{/}
Water of the Past#007.note: {c1}"But where were the shining army of red and yellow when our supply was attacked?"{/}

Water of the Past#008.src: "Hiding in the sewers while we perish."
Water of the Past#008.dst: {c1}「私たちが滅びゆく間、下水道に身を潜めている。」{/}
Water of the Past#008.note: {c1}"Hiding in the sewers while we perish."{/}

Water of the Past#009.dst: {c1}「この戦争に勝つことなどできない。」{/}
